project: Namias Portfolio - Realtime Sanity CMS → Website Updates (no manual refresh)
summary: When the owner publishes or edits any document in Sanity CMS, the live portfolio website must update automatically in every open browser tab without a manual refresh. The feature builds on the existing signed webhook (tag-based L1/L2 cache invalidation + revalidatePath), adds a monotonic content-version heartbeat that the webhook bumps, exposes it via /api/sanity/live, and mounts a version-aware client polling bridge in the root layout that calls router.refresh() only when the version changes. A complete Playwright E2E layer is introduced from scratch (config, dependency, env-gated CMS fixture seam, smoke specs, and a deterministic realtime spec that mutates the fixture, fires the webhook, and asserts the page updates without reload), wired into CI.
narrative: Today, publishing in Sanity invalidates caches and paths server-side (the next request is fresh), but an already-open browser tab shows stale content until the visitor manually reloads or navigates. The repo already contains most of the machinery: a signed webhook route with tag-based invalidation, a two-layer cache (in-memory + Redis) with 300s TTL / 60s stale, draft mode with VisualEditing for the studio preview, and a dormant client polling hook (useSanityLiveRefresh, 45s blind router.refresh()) that is mounted nowhere. The missing pieces are: (1) a lightweight content version signal so the client can detect 'something changed' instead of refreshing on a fixed schedule; (2) mounting a version-aware refresh bridge in the layout gated by a feature flag; (3) a deterministic E2E test bed (Playwright) that proves the whole loop — CMS mutation equivalent → webhook → version bump → client poll → router.refresh() → fresh SSR content — works automatically, plus smoke tests for the home page, blog, and connect sections. The design deliberately avoids the Sanity Live Content API / useLiveQuery retrofit (would require converting server-rendered context consumers to client queries and exposing a browser token); the version-heartbeat + router.refresh() approach keeps the existing streaming SSR architecture intact and works in every environment (Vercel + Cloudflare) without new Sanity project features.
principles: Build on what exists - the signed webhook, tag invalidation, revalidatePath, and the dormant polling hook are the foundation; no new CMS, no schema changes, no new document types.
Refresh only when something changed - the client polls a version number, never refreshes on a timer alone; zero unnecessary RSC re-renders.
Feature-flagged - the bridge and the E2E seam are gated (IS_REALTIME_SANITY_ENABLED, env-only E2E_CMS_FILE) so production behavior is opt-in and safe.
No secrets in the browser - the client only reads a public version integer; the webhook secret stays server-side.
Resilient by default - Redis down, version read failures, or webhook body parse failures degrade to current behavior (TTL-based freshness), never crash.
Deterministic tests - E2E uses an env-gated local CMS fixture (no real Sanity dependency, no flakiness), while unit tests mock querySanity per the established pattern.
One story slice per commit - every story in this PRD lands as its own commit with quality gates green (vitest, tsc, lint, doctor:check 100).

designDecisions.choice: Version heartbeat + client polling + router.refresh() instead of the Sanity Live Content API.
designDecisions.rationale: The site renders CMS content server-side via streaming SSR context; retrofitting every consumer to useLiveQuery would be a rewrite and would expose a browser token. A version integer the webhook bumps and a client that refreshes only on change achieves 'no manual refresh' with minimal surface, works on Vercel and Cloudflare, and reuses the dormant polling hook.

designDecisions.choice: Redis-backed monotonic counter (INCR) with an in-memory fallback, exposed by src/lib/content-version.ts.
designDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing redis-cache resilience pattern (catch → fallback). The version is public and harmless; it only answers 'did anything change since I last looked?'.

designDecisions.choice: The existing /api/sanity/webhook route bumps the version after successful validation, alongside tag invalidation and revalidatePath.
designDecisions.rationale: One authoritative mutation path. The dashboard-configured webhook already delivers every publish/edit/delete; bumping there keeps a single source of truth.

designDecisions.choice: Poll /api/sanity/live every NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_LIVE_POLL_MS (default 15s, E2E uses ~300ms); refresh only when the version differs; also refresh on focus/visibilitychange; skip draft mode.
designDecisions.rationale: Version-diff refresh eliminates blind timer refreshes. Focus/visibility refresh covers tab-switch staleness for free. Draft mode already renders fresh content with VisualEditing, so polling is skipped there.

designDecisions.choice: querySanity checks E2E_CMS_FILE (server env): when set, reads a local JSON fixture fresh per call (matching the GROQ _type via a small registry), skipping Sanity and all caching.
designDecisions.rationale: Gives Playwright a deterministic content source it can mutate mid-test. Only active when the env var is set (never in prod); unit-tested; keeps every other test pattern intact.

designDecisions.choice: @playwright/test in portfolio-v1 only; chromium project; webServer boots next dev on port 3100 with E2E env; service workers blocked in the browser context.
designDecisions.rationale: portfolio-v1 is the production site. Chromium only keeps CI fast; the workflow replaces the orphaned pnpm-root workflow with an npm + chromium version. Blocking SWs avoids PWA cache interference with refresh assertions.

designDecisions.choice: The realtime spec rewrites the fixture JSON (v1 → v2), POSTs a signed webhook payload, then asserts the page text updates without any reload.
designDecisions.rationale: Exercises the complete loop: mutation → webhook → version bump → poll → router.refresh() → fresh SSR. No real Sanity credentials or network flakiness.

designDecisions.choice: IS_REALTIME_SANITY_ENABLED in src/lib/features.ts gates the mounted bridge (default true after Phase 2, same pattern as IS_STREAMING_SSR_ENABLED).
designDecisions.rationale: Established flag pattern; allows the owner to disable the bridge without code removal.

epics.title: Audit & PRD
epics.summary: Audited the existing Sanity pipeline (webhook, L1/L2 cache, draft mode, dormant polling hook) and the testing infrastructure (Vitest mature, Playwright absent), then authored this PRD.

stories.title: Audit Sanity integration and revalidation
stories.details: Mapped cms-content.server.ts (querySanity, CONTENT_TAGS, L1/L2 getOrFetch), the webhook route, draft mode, section loaders, layout streaming, and all API routes.

stories.title: Audit testing infrastructure
stories.details: Confirmed 116 Vitest files/1052 tests, no Playwright dependency/config/tests, orphaned playwright.yml, PRD schema from prd.blog.json.

stories.title: Write PRD
stories.details: Author prd.realtime-sanity.json with epics, stories, metrics, design decisions, and phase plan.

epics.title: Server: content version heartbeat
epics.summary: Add a monotonic content version (Redis + in-memory fallback), bump it in the webhook, expose it through /api/sanity/live, and extend webhook unit coverage.

stories.title: Add content-version store
stories.details: Create src/lib/content-version.ts: getContentVersion() and bumpContentVersion() backed by redis INCR (new redis-cache helpers) with an in-memory counter fallback; export the key and defaults. Unit-test Redis-down and normal paths.

stories.title: Bump version in webhook
stories.details: In POST /api/sanity/webhook, after secret validation and before responding, call bumpContentVersion() (non-fatal on failure). Extend sanity-webhook-route tests: body _type → correct invalidateByTag calls, version bump, RAG branch mocked, body-less payload still revalidates.

stories.title: Expose version on /api/sanity/live
stories.details: Extend GET /api/sanity/live to return { ok, version, draftMode, pollIntervalMs, revalidatePaths } (keep ?enable=1 compat). Add sanity-live-route tests: version present, CORS, OPTIONS, draft flag.

epics.title: Client: version-aware auto-refresh bridge
epics.summary: Upgrade the dormant polling hook to version-aware polling and mount it in the root layout behind a feature flag.

stories.title: Upgrade useSanityLiveRefresh to version-aware polling
stories.details: Poll GET /api/sanity/live every NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_LIVE_POLL_MS (default 15_000); call router.refresh() only when the returned version differs from the last seen one; skip when draft mode is on; keep focus/visibility triggers and MIN_REFRESH_GAP; extend paths to /projects and /projects/[slug]. Rewrite the hook test with fake timers: no refresh when version unchanged, refresh on change, interval from env.

stories.title: Mount bridge and add feature flag
stories.details: Add IS_REALTIME_SANITY_ENABLED to src/lib/features.ts (default true) and mount <SanityLiveRefreshBridge /> in the root layout body when the flag is on and not in draft mode. Update layout/app tests to cover the mounted bridge and the flag-off path.

epics.title: E2E infrastructure (Playwright)
epics.summary: Introduce Playwright from scratch: dependency, config, scripts, fixtures, and an env-gated CMS fixture seam.

stories.title: Add Playwright dependency and config
stories.details: npm i -D @playwright/test in portfolio-v1; create playwright.config.ts (testDir tests/e2e, chromium project, webServer next dev on port 3100 with E2E env, serviceWorkers block, trace on retry); add scripts test:e2e / test:e2e:ui / test:e2e:report; add tests/e2e/.gitkeep + README note.

stories.title: Add env-gated CMS fixture seam
stories.details: In querySanity (cms-content.server.ts): when process.env.E2E_CMS_FILE is set, read the JSON fixture fresh on every call, resolve the _type from the GROQ query via a small regex registry, and return fixture data with no caching. Unit-test: seam active with env, inactive without, missing type falls through to the real path.

stories.title: Write E2E smoke specs
stories.details: Specs: home.spec.ts (hero name, sections render, no console errors), blog.spec.ts (list + post detail from fixture), connect.spec.ts (social chips incl. Discord label).

epics.title: E2E realtime spec + CI
epics.summary: Prove the full realtime loop end-to-end and wire Playwright into CI.

stories.title: Write the realtime E2E spec
stories.details: realtime.spec.ts: load home with fixture v1 (assert name A), rewrite fixture file to v2 (name B), POST /api/sanity/webhook with valid secret and { _type: 'profile' }, then expect.poll that the page shows name B without any reload (poll interval 300ms via env).

stories.title: Webhook-auth E2E spec
stories.details: auth.spec.ts: POST to /api/sanity/webhook without/with wrong secret → 401 and no version bump; with correct secret → 200 and version increments on the next /api/sanity/live call.

stories.title: Fix the Playwright CI workflow
stories.details: Rewrite .github/workflows/playwright.yml: scope to portfolio-v1, setup-node 22 + npm ci, npx playwright install --with-deps chromium, run test:e2e, upload report/screenshots on failure. Keep matrix at chromium only.

epics.title: Docs, PRD update, and wrap-up
epics.summary: Document the architecture, update the PRD status, and run the full quality gate.

stories.title: Write realtime architecture doc
stories.details: Add portfolio-v1/docs/REALTIME_SANITY.md: flow diagram, env vars (SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET, NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_LIVE_POLL_MS, E2E_CMS_FILE), how to run unit + E2E tests, dashboard webhook setup recap.

stories.title: Update PRD status and PR.md
stories.details: Mark epics/stories done as implemented; run scripts/append-pr-update.ps1 and commit PR.md per the AGENTS.md workflow.

openQuestions: Should the dashboard webhook stay the only bump source, or should the studio publish action (publishAndRefreshAction) also be fixed to send the secret header and _type? (Current studio-triggered call is broken — 401 + no _type; dashboard webhook is the working path.)
Poll interval default of 15s: acceptable freshness, or should the owner prefer 5s in exchange for more requests?
Should the realtime bridge also cover /projects and /projects/[slug] (currently planned) or only / and /blog?
Do we want a manual 'refresh now' affordance (e.g. a small toast 'Content updated — tap to refresh') in a follow-up PRD?
